PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.introduction_text: This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect user data on our platform. We are committed to safeguarding your personal information and maintaining your trust.
PrivacyPolicy.data_collection_text: We collect personal data only when you voluntarily provide it through account registration, course enrollment, contact forms, or payment processing. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and payment information.
PrivacyPolicy.data_usage_text: Your data is used to provide course access, send educational content, process payments, respond to inquiries, and improve our platform services. We do not sell or share your data with third parties without your consent.
PrivacyPolicy.data_protection_text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, and disclosure. All payment information is encrypted and handled securely.
PrivacyPolicy.user_rights_text: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data at any time. You can manage your account settings or contact us to exercise these rights.
PrivacyPolicy.cookies_text: Our website uses cookies to enhance your experience and track site usage. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.
PrivacyPolicy.third_party_text: We may use third-party services for analytics and payment processing. These services have their own privacy policies and data handling practices. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our courses and platform
FAQ.answer1: We offer a wide range of online courses including programming, design, business, and more. Each course is designed by industry experts to help you gain practical skills.
FAQ.question2: How do I enroll in a course?
FAQ.answer2: Simply browse our course catalog, select the course you want, and click the 'Add to Cart' button. Then proceed to checkout to complete your enrollment.
FAQ.answer3: Yes, most of our courses are self-paced, allowing you to learn at your own speed. However, some courses may have specific schedules and deadlines.
FAQ.question4: Do I get a certificate after completion?
FAQ.answer4: Yes, upon successful completion of a course, you will receive a certificate that you can share on your LinkedIn profile or resume.
FAQ.question5: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQ.answer5: We accept various payment methods including VNPay for Vietnamese users, and international credit/debit cards for global students.
FAQ.question6: Can I get a refund if I am not satisfied?
FAQ.answer6: Yes, we offer a refund policy. If you are not satisfied with a course, you can request a refund within a specified period according to our refund policy.
FAQ.contactMessage: Feel free to contact our support team for any additional questions
